name: Chapped Lips
description: Chapped lips occur when the skin on the lips becomes dry, cracked, and sometimes painful. This condition can be a result of various factors including environmental conditions, dehydration, certain medical conditions, or the use of certain products.
causes: Exposure to extreme weather (cold, wind, or low humidity)
Using harsh lip balms or lipsticks with drying ingredients
Certain medical conditions such as cold sores, eczema, or dermatitis
risk_factors: Living in cold climates with dry air
Certain medical conditions that affect skin health
Aging, as the lips naturally lose moisture and elasticity over time
ingredients_to_avoid: Preservatives that can irritate the skin

daily_routine.step: Apply a thin layer of moisturizer before going to bed
daily_routine.purpose: To lock in moisture overnight and prevent chapping
Licking can cause further dryness by evaporating the natural lip moisture

professional_treatments: Phototherapy for certain medical conditions causing chapped lips
natural_remedies: Using honey as a natural humectant
Rinsing with warm water to soothe the lips
lifestyle_tips: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water
Use a humidifier in dry environments
Wear a lip balm or protective sunscreen when outdoors
common_myths: Licking your lips helps moisturize them.
Chapped lips are always caused by dehydration.
when_to_consult_doctor: If the condition persists, worsens, or is accompanied by fever, swelling, or pus-filled blisters.
prevention: Avoiding harsh exfoliants on your lips
Protecting your lips from sun and wind

severity_levels.mild: Minor dryness with occasional peeling or flakiness. No significant pain.
severity_levels.moderate: Visible cracks, redness, and mild to moderate discomfort. May require topical treatment for relief.
severity_levels.severe: Severe cracking, bleeding, and intense pain. Immediate medical attention may be necessary.

expert_tips: Choose lip products that do not contain irritating ingredients
Do a patch test before applying new products to the lips
